newsitem.title: FRANCE: Spain's Larios accepts Pernod buyout offer.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Larios accepts Pernod buyout offer.

text.p: The board of Spanish gin maker Larios on Thursday accepted a buyout offer from French drinks group Pernod Ricard.

"The board of Larios, which represents more than 60 percent of the capital of the company, decided today to accept Pernod Ricard's purchase offer and submit it for the approval of the company's other shareholders," Pernod said in a statement.
The deal, whose terms were not disclosed, was set to close on June 27.
Pernod said that at its next board meeting it would be proposed that Rafael Gonzalez-Gallarza Morales, president of Larios, become an administrator of Pernod Ricard.
Patrick Ricard and Thierry Jacquillat, Pernod Ricard executives, should at the same time join the board of Larios.
